item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-05-04
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 CellScript 语言迎来 0.13.2 稳定版收尾更新，核心重点是发布加固与标准库审计模式的引入，标志着 0.13 产品线正式关闭。[S01, S02] 与此同时，Spark 开发者孵化计划的参与者提交了 Milestone 2 首周进度报告，显示 Milestone 1 已完成、新阶段工作已在本地仓库推进。[S03] ## 重点话题 **CellScript 0.13.2 稳定版发布**：ArthurZhang 推出 0.13 产品线的最终稳定版本，重点并非编译器功能更新，而是发布加固（release hardening），包括严格的 CKB 接受性验证，以提升可靠性。[S01] **标准库审计模式首次落地**：0.13.2 引入了首个稳定的标准库审计模式，设计意图不是用魔法语法掩盖 CKB Cell 语义，而是为开发者提供更清晰的语言层支持。[S02] **Spark 计划 Milestone 2 启动**：参与者 xingtianchunyan 的 Week 1 报告显示，Milestone 1 已完成，Milestone 2 的本地仓库工作已结束，整体进入第三周。[S03] ## 值得继续跟进 CellScript 0.14 或下一版本线的路线图尚未披露，需观察 ArthurZhang 何时公布 0.14 方向及是否包含重大语法或状态模型调整。[S01, S02] Spark 计划 Milestone 2 的具体交付物目前仅在本地仓库完成，需关注何时能公开可见的代码或文档产出。[S03]...

item.title: CellScript - A DSL for Cell-Based Contracts (1 posts)
item.description: CellScript v0.13.2: closing the 0.13 stable line with strict CKB acceptance evidence CellScript v0.13.2 is now ready as the stable closing release for the 0.13 line. This release is not only a compiler update. The main focus of 0.13.2 is release hardening: making the syntax surface more stable, keeping Cell effects audit-visible, and strengthening the CKB acceptance evidence behind the bundled production examples. What changed in 0.13? The 0.13 line introduced and stabilised several important areas: bounded stack-backed Vec<T: FixedWidth> helper support; canonical action/update syntax with named outputs, where proof blocks, and explicit move state edges; visible lock-boundary data sources...

item.title: CellScript 0.13 Direction Update: Actions, State, and Syntax (1 posts)
item.description: 0.13.2 Patch Preview Preview: Standard Library Patterns Arrive CellScript 0.13.2 adds the first stable standard-library audit patterns. This is a small but important step for the language. The goal is not to hide CKB Cell semantics behind magic syntax. The goal is to give common verifier patterns a clear, namespaced spelling while keeping their lowering explicit and auditable. The new standard-library surface includes lifecycle helpers: std::lifecycle::transfer(input, output, to) { amount symbol } std::receipt::claim(receipt, output, lock) { amount } std::lifecycle::settle(input, output, lock) { amount } It also includes Cell metadata helpers: std::cell::same_lock(output, input)...
